shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
justification: Both are brown stone reliefs showing a humanoid figure whose torso area carries a prominent circular disc surrounded by incised linear patterning, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a heavily eroded free-standing monolith with crude, shallow, barely legible motifs read as a whole body, while B is a flat wall slab detail with crisp, disciplined carving of feathered wings and beaded fringes at a much finer scale.
